description: Lysica wears an opaque plum-purple floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold woven floral/geometric borders outline the neckline, shoulder straps, sleeve ends, waist, center-front skirt opening and hem. Two round gold brooches fasten the upper straps, and a decorated belt has a round center clasp. A pale linen underskirt shows through the below-knee front opening. A pale bordered wrap rests around her forearms, with gold earrings, a small pendant and a broad worked bracelet. Both gold-brown closed shoes are visible beneath the hem. There is no headgear, armor or weapon; substantial opaque fabric covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis.
